limits: Retrieval/synthesis aid only; no new manuscript finding, lexical progress, word meaning, POS or operator assignment.
Counts are exact standalone raw forms in the exposed179-selector profile population; selector dispersion is not physical-folio dispersion. Embedded strings and alternate readers are not pooled.
Positions are source-line positions, not grammar. Repeated adjacent forms are retained; no event identity inferred.
The three optional worksheet expansions are not used. Each original whole form receives its own profile.

Length is raw Unicode codepoints; the secondary22-unit tokenizer is an analytical convention, not phonemes or a proved native alphabet. Longest selection uses raw codepoint length, ties lexical; highlight categories may overlap.
WE cards are navigation links and limits only; no historical content gloss is imported.
Global previous/next neighbor summaries are exact profile results, not independently established grammatical relations.
No new source/image admission, reserve, raw TSV parsing, statistical test, model fitting or normalized glyph forms.
